end.summary:
Practised representing numbers 11–20 as one bundle of ten and loose ones.
Made 4 attempts; 1 was unaided correct.
Represented 13 as 10 and 3 more.
Confused counting the bundle as 1 item instead of 10; this was corrected later in the lesson.

end.parentNote: Saanvi practised showing a number as one bundle of ten and some loose sticks. Using the spoken count “ten, eleven, twelve…” helped them represent 13 as 10 and 3 more. There was a mix-up about whether the bundle counts as 1 or 10, and this was corrected later in the lesson. At home, make one bundle of 10 straws and add loose straws, then ask, “How many in all?”
